direct_claims: This chart is about the world’s urban and rural population from 10,000 BCE to 2050.
It belongs to the domain of demography and urbanization.
The subtitle states that it combines UN estimates and projections with modelled historical data going back to 10,000 BCE.
The chart appears to have been published by Our World in Data.
The data sources named on the chart are HYDE (2023) and the United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2025).

Because the chart spans from 10,000 BCE to 2050, it combines reconstructed historical population patterns with modern statistical estimates and future projections rather than relying on one single measurement system across the whole timeline.
The chart explicitly includes projected values through 2050 rather than stopping at the present.
The vertical scale is labeled in billions of people, indicating that the chart tracks absolute population counts rather than percentages or shares.
